sentences.text:
Shri R.S. Yadav, Advocate for appellant from Legal Aid.
 Shri Deependra Singh Kushwaha, Additional Advocate Genera  respondent/State.
Heard on I.A. No.22580/2025 , third application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of sole appellant - Ramcharan Ahirwar for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

2. This criminal appeal assails the judgment dated 18.01.2016 passed by First Additional Sessions Judge, District Vidisha (M.P.) in S.S.T. No.66/2015; whereby, present appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under :-
Sections Conviction Fine with default stipulation 376(2) of IPC Life Imprisonment Rs.2,000/-
3 .

entities.text: First Additional Sessions Judge, District Vidisha (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is the submissions of counsel for appellant that the Trial Court erred in convicting and awarding jail sentence to appellant.
At present, appellant has suffered around 10 years and 9 months of incarceration as pre and post trial confinement.

It is further submitted that in evidence of father of victim (PW-2), this fact came to the surface that there was a dispute between father of victim and present appellant, therefore, as submitted he has been falsely implicated.
Even brother of victim (PW-3) also submitted that his father wanted to implicate the appellant.
Medical report belies the allegation 2 CRA-409-2016 because no injury was found over the person of victim.
FSL also is not positive.

Looking to the period of custody and the fact that hearing of appeal shall take some time as well as evidence surfaced, appellant may be granted benefit of suspension of sentence and he may be released on bail.
4. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of application.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and record perused.

sentences.text:
Considering the submissions advanced and the facts that medical report/FSL does not support the story of prosecution as well as issue of enmity between the families cannot be ruled out, period of custody, which is around 10 years and 9 months of incarceration as pre and post trial confinement, it appears that appellant has made out ground for suspension of sentence, therefore,
without commenting anything on the merits of the case, I . A . stands allowed and it is directed that the jail sentence of present appellant shall remain suspended during pendency of the present appeal and he shall be released on bail subject to verification of the factum of depositing the fine amount and on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court concerned.
The appellant is directed to appear before the Registry of this Court first on 27.04.2026 and on other subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf.
7. Accordingly, the application stands disposed of.
8. Observations on facts, if any, are only for the purpose of deciding the instant I.A. and shall have no bearing on the merits of the appeal.
